entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something. I bought a VeloBand Pulse a couple of weeks ago and it's just not working out for me.
I understand. I can certainly help you with a return. Could you please provide me with your order number or the email address associated with the purchase of your VeloBand Pulse?
It's [customer's email address]. And hurry up, I don't have all day.

Thank you. Let me pull up your order… Okay, I see your purchase of the VeloBand Pulse. I understand you'd like to return it. To confirm, the device is in its original condition with all original packaging?
Yeah, yeah, everything is as it was. So, can I just send it back?

Absolutely. At VeloFit, we have a 90-day return policy on most of our items to ensure you are happy with your purchase. Since you are within that window, processing your return for the VeloBand Pulse is no problem at all.
Ninety days? Seriously? I thought I was past the return window. I read something about it being shorter for this smart watch.

While some accessories have slightly different policies, the standard return policy of 90 days applies to the VeloBand Pulse as well. I can go ahead and generate a return label for you. You'll just need to package the device securely and ship it back to us.
Okay, great. Just send me the label. I appreciate it. I was worried I'd be stuck with it.

You're very welcome. I'm glad I could help. Just a reminder, once we receive the returned VeloBand Pulse, we'll process your refund within 7-10 business days. You’ll receive an email confirmation once the refund has been issued. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Thanks for the help. I was really worried about this, especially since I thought the return policy was only 10 days or something. You saved me a major headache.
You're very welcome! We aim to make returns as easy as possible. Have a great day!
